```{r}
# Pakete:
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "lubridate", "plotly", "reactable", "scales", "bslib", "bsicons", "htmltools", "htmlwidgets", "jsonlite"))

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(reactable)
library(scales)
library(bslib)
library(bsicons)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(jsonlite)

csv_file <- "controlling_gb2av_vollzugsmeldung_delta_202605121757.csv"
stichtag <- as.Date("2018-01-01")

raw <- readr::read_csv(
  csv_file,
  col_types = cols(
    t_id = col_integer(),
    t_ili_tid = col_character(),
    mutationsnummer = col_character(),
    nbident = col_character(),
    gb_status = col_character(),
    gb_bemerkungen = col_character(),
    gb_grundbucheintrag = col_date(),
    gb_tagebucheintrag = col_date(),
    gb_tagebuchbeleg = col_character(),
    av_beschreibung = col_character(),
    av_gueltigkeit = col_character(),
    av_gueltigereintrag = col_date(),
    av_gbeintrag = col_date(),
    av_firma = col_character(),
    datasetname = col_character(),
    grundstuecksart = col_character(),
    delta = col_integer()
  )
)

# Auswertung ab Stichtag.
# Falls das Dashboard wirklich alle Records zeigen soll: diese Filterzeile entfernen.
daten <- raw |>
  filter(gb_grundbucheintrag > stichtag) |>
  mutate(
    fristklasse = case_when(
      delta <= 7 ~ "≤ 7 Tage",
      delta <= 14 ~ "8–14 Tage",
      delta <= 30 ~ "15–30 Tage",
      delta <= 60 ~ "31–60 Tage",
      TRUE ~ "> 60 Tage"
    ),
    fristklasse = factor(
      fristklasse,
      levels = c("≤ 7 Tage", "8–14 Tage", "15–30 Tage", "31–60 Tage", "> 60 Tage")
    ),
    innerhalb_1_woche = delta <= 7,
    nicht_innerhalb_1_woche = delta > 7,
    nicht_innerhalb_2_wochen = delta > 14,
    monat = floor_date(gb_grundbucheintrag, "month")
  )

summarise_firma <- function(x) {
  x |>
    group_by(av_firma) |>
    summarise(
      total = n(),
      innerhalb_1_woche = sum(innerhalb_1_woche, na.rm = TRUE),
      nicht_innerhalb_1_woche = sum(nicht_innerhalb_1_woche, na.rm = TRUE),
      nicht_innerhalb_2_wochen = sum(nicht_innerhalb_2_wochen, na.rm = TRUE),
      anteil_innerhalb_1_woche = innerhalb_1_woche / total,
      median_delta = median(delta, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_delta = mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_delta = max(delta, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(nicht_innerhalb_2_wochen), desc(nicht_innerhalb_1_woche), desc(total))
}

stand <- max(daten$gb_grundbucheintrag, na.rm = TRUE)

# Beobachtungsfenster für die Controlling-Tabelle.
# Die Fenster sind relativ zum jüngsten GB-Grundbucheintrag im CSV definiert,
# nicht relativ zum Render-Datum.
summary_firma <- summarise_firma(daten)
summary_firma_letzter_monat <- daten |>
  filter(gb_grundbucheintrag >= stand %m-% months(1)) |>
  summarise_firma()
summary_firma_letzte_6_monate <- daten |>
  filter(gb_grundbucheintrag >= stand %m-% months(6)) |>
  summarise_firma()

firma_choices <- c("Alle Firmen", sort(unique(daten$av_firma)))

make_select <- function(id, label, choices, values = choices, onchange = NULL) {
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "dashboard-filter",
    htmltools::tags$label(`for` = id, label),
    htmltools::tags$select(
      id = id,
      class = "dashboard-filter-select",
      onchange = onchange,
      purrr::map2(values, choices, ~ htmltools::tags$option(value = .x, .y))
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Vollzugsmeldungen pro Firma"

p <- summary_firma |>
  mutate(av_firma = fct_reorder(av_firma, total)) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = av_firma,
    y = total,
    text = paste0(
      "Firma: ", av_firma,
      "<br>Total: ", total,
      "<br>≤ 7 Tage: ", innerhalb_1_woche,
      "<br>> 7 Tage: ", nicht_innerhalb_1_woche,
      "<br>> 14 Tage: ", nicht_innerhalb_2_wochen,
      "<br>Median Delta: ", median_delta
    )
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Anzahl") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Controlling-Tabelle"

make_controlling_table <- function(x) {
  x <- x |> arrange(av_firma)

  reactable(
    x,
    defaultPageSize = 10,
    defaultSorted = list(av_firma = "asc"),
    columns = list(
      av_firma = colDef(name = "Firma", minWidth = 250),
      total = colDef(name = "Total", align = "right"),
      innerhalb_1_woche = colDef(name = "≤ 7 Tage", align = "right"),
      nicht_innerhalb_1_woche = colDef(name = "> 7 Tage", align = "right"),
      nicht_innerhalb_2_wochen = colDef(name = "> 14 Tage", align = "right"),
      anteil_innerhalb_1_woche = colDef(
        name = "Anteil ≤ 7 Tage",
        align = "right",
        format = colFormat(percent = TRUE, digits = 1)
      ),
      median_delta = colDef(name = "Median Delta", align = "right"),
      mean_delta = colDef(
        name = "Ø Delta",
        align = "right",
        format = colFormat(digits = 1)
      ),
      max_delta = colDef(name = "Max Delta", align = "right")
    )
  )
}

htmltools::tagList(
  make_select(
    id = "controlling-window-select",
    label = "Beobachtungsfenster",
    choices = c("Alles", "Letzter Monat", "Letzte 6 Monate"),
    values = c("all", "month", "sixmonths"),
    onchange = "setControllingWindow(this.value)"
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(id = "controlling-table-all", make_controlling_table(summary_firma)),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    id = "controlling-table-month",
    style = "display: none;",
    make_controlling_table(summary_firma_letzter_monat)
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    id = "controlling-table-sixmonths",
    style = "display: none;",
    make_controlling_table(summary_firma_letzte_6_monate)
  ),
  htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(
    paste0(
      "function setControllingWindow(value) {\n",
      "  var ids = ['all', 'month', 'sixmonths'];\n",
      "  ids.forEach(function(id) {\n",
      "    var el = document.getElementById('controlling-table-' + id);\n",
      "    if (el) { el.style.display = (id === value) ? 'block' : 'none'; }\n",
      "  });\n",
      "}\n"
    )
  ))
)
```

  count(av_firma, fristklasse, name = "anzahl")

  geom_col() +

```{r}
#| title: "Verteilung Delta in Tagen"

hist_groups <- firma_choices
hist_group_ids <- seq_along(hist_groups)

hist_plot <- plot_ly()

for (i in hist_group_ids) {
  firma <- hist_groups[[i]]

  hist_data <- if (firma == "Alle Firmen") {
    daten
  } else {
    daten |> filter(av_firma == firma)
  }

  hist_plot <- hist_plot |>
    add_histogram(
      x = hist_data$delta,
      name = firma,
      xbins = list(start = 0, size = 5),
      visible = i == 1,
      hovertemplate = paste0(
        "Firma: ", firma,
        "<br>Delta: %{x} Tage",
        "<br>Anzahl: %{y}",
        "<extra></extra>"
      )
    )
}

hist_plot <- hist_plot |>
  layout(
    bargap = 0.05,
    margin = list(t = 12),
    xaxis = list(title = "Delta in Tagen"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Anzahl"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

hist_js <- "
function(el, x) {
  var select = document.getElementById('hist-firma-select');
  if (!select) return;

  function update() {
    var selected = parseInt(select.value, 10);
    var visible = x.data.map(function(_, idx) { return (idx + 1) === selected; });
    Plotly.restyle(el, { visible: visible });
  }

  select.addEventListener('change', update);
  update();
}
"

htmltools::tagList(
  make_select(
    id = "hist-firma-select",
    label = "Firma",
    choices = hist_groups,
    values = hist_group_ids
  ),
  htmlwidgets::onRender(hist_plot, hist_js)
)
```

# Zeitverlauf

## Row

```{r}
#| title: "Monatlicher Verlauf nach Fristklasse"

zeit_basis <- bind_rows(
  daten |> mutate(firma_filter = "Alle Firmen"),
  daten |> mutate(firma_filter = av_firma)
) |>
  count(firma_filter, monat, fristklasse, name = "anzahl") |>
  mutate(monat_label = format(monat, "%Y-%m"))

frist_levels <- levels(daten$fristklasse)
zeit_groups <- firma_choices
zeit_group_ids <- seq_along(zeit_groups)

zeit_plot <- plot_ly()
trace_group_id <- integer(0)

for (firma_idx in zeit_group_ids) {
  firma <- zeit_groups[[firma_idx]]

  for (frist in frist_levels) {
    trace_group_id <- c(trace_group_id, firma_idx)

    trace_data <- zeit_basis |>
      filter(firma_filter == firma, fristklasse == frist) |>
      arrange(monat)

    zeit_plot <- zeit_plot |>
      add_bars(
        data = trace_data,
        x = ~monat,
        y = ~anzahl,
        name = frist,
        visible = firma_idx == 1,
        legendgroup = frist,
        showlegend = TRUE,
        text = ~paste0(
          "Firma: ", firma_filter,
          "<br>Monat: ", monat_label,
          "<br>Frist: ", fristklasse,
          "<br>Anzahl: ", anzahl
        ),
        hoverinfo = "text"
      )
  }
}

zeit_plot <- zeit_plot |>
  layout(
    barmode = "stack",
    margin = list(t = 12),
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Anzahl"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Fristklasse"))
  )

zeit_trace_group_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(trace_group_id, auto_unbox = TRUE)
zeit_js <- paste0("
function(el, x) {
  var select = document.getElementById('zeit-firma-select');
  var traceGroups = ", zeit_trace_group_json, ";
  if (!select) return;

  function update() {
    var selected = parseInt(select.value, 10);
    var visible = traceGroups.map(function(groupId) { return groupId === selected; });
    Plotly.restyle(el, { visible: visible });
  }

  select.addEventListener('change', update);
  update();
}
")

htmltools::tagList(
  make_select(
    id = "zeit-firma-select",
    label = "Firma",
    choices = zeit_groups,
    values = zeit_group_ids
  ),
  htmlwidgets::onRender(zeit_plot, zeit_js)
)
```

```{r}
#| title: "Verspätete Meldungen pro Monat"

verspaetet_basis <- bind_rows(
  daten |> mutate(firma_filter = "Alle Firmen"),
  daten |> mutate(firma_filter = av_firma)
) |>
  group_by(firma_filter, monat) |>
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    nicht_innerhalb_1_woche = sum(delta > 7, na.rm = TRUE),
    nicht_innerhalb_2_wochen = sum(delta > 14, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(nicht_innerhalb_1_woche, nicht_innerhalb_2_wochen),
    names_to = "kennzahl",
    values_to = "anzahl"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    kennzahl = recode(
      kennzahl,
      nicht_innerhalb_1_woche = "> 7 Tage",
      nicht_innerhalb_2_wochen = "> 14 Tage"
    ),
    monat_label = format(monat, "%Y-%m")
  ) |>
  arrange(firma_filter, kennzahl, monat)

kennzahl_levels <- c("> 7 Tage", "> 14 Tage")
versp_groups <- firma_choices
versp_group_ids <- seq_along(versp_groups)

versp_plot <- plot_ly()
trace_group_id <- integer(0)

for (firma_idx in versp_group_ids) {
  firma <- versp_groups[[firma_idx]]

  for (kennzahl_item in kennzahl_levels) {
    trace_group_id <- c(trace_group_id, firma_idx)

    trace_data <- verspaetet_basis |>
      filter(firma_filter == firma, kennzahl == kennzahl_item) |>
      arrange(monat)

    versp_plot <- versp_plot |>
      add_trace(
        data = trace_data,
        x = ~monat,
        y = ~anzahl,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = kennzahl_item,
        visible = firma_idx == 1,
        legendgroup = kennzahl_item,
        showlegend = TRUE,
        text = ~paste0(
          "Firma: ", firma_filter,
          "<br>Monat: ", monat_label,
          "<br>", kennzahl, ": ", anzahl
        ),
        hoverinfo = "text"
      )
  }
}

versp_plot <- versp_plot |>
  layout(
    margin = list(t = 12),
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Anzahl"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = ""))
  )

versp_trace_group_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(trace_group_id, auto_unbox = TRUE)
versp_js <- paste0("
function(el, x) {
  var select = document.getElementById('versp-firma-select');
  var traceGroups = ", versp_trace_group_json, ";
  if (!select) return;

  function update() {
    var selected = parseInt(select.value, 10);
    var visible = traceGroups.map(function(groupId) { return groupId === selected; });
    Plotly.restyle(el, { visible: visible });
  }

  select.addEventListener('change', update);
  update();
}
")

htmltools::tagList(
  make_select(
    id = "versp-firma-select",
    label = "Firma",
    choices = versp_groups,
    values = versp_group_ids
  ),
  htmlwidgets::onRender(versp_plot, versp_js)
)
```
